snippet.title: Let's Play - Winged Warrior I for DOS - 1
snippet.description: Winged Warrior I was one of the first RPGs on my PC I ever played and therefore holds a special place in my heart. I only had the demo level, which ended with the destruction of the alien base. I always loved the pixel-graphics, the relaxing soundtrack and the simplistic gameplay-style. But it also has a downside: It's pretty linear and you can't stray from your path in any way - which reduces it's replay value to some degree.... But who cares! WE ARE THE WINGED WARRIOR, WOOHOOO! LET'S KICK ALIENS AND FROGS! ;D
